scholarships.name: Arden University Regional Scholarship
scholarships.requirements: Must be a resident of an eligible region (e.g. Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan); must apply for an undergraduate blended learning or online program; must demonstrate how the degree will benefit their local community in a 300-word statement.
scholarships.description: Arden offers region-specific bursaries to support students from developing economies. This award reduces the 2026 tuition fees to make modern, flexible learning more affordable for international career-switchers.
